hero.title: A $1.1 million crypto card hack crashed a neobank's token 49%
hero.description: The exploit caused the neobank's AVICI token to drop 49% from a 24-hour high, hitting a record low before paring some of the losses.

latest.title: A $1.1 million crypto card hack crashed a neobank's token 49%
latest.description: The exploit caused the neobank's AVICI token to drop 49% from a 24-hour high, hitting a record low before paring some of the losses.

latest.title: Polygon discloses security flaws fixed in recent hard forks
latest.description: The vulnerabilities posed denial-of-service and validator resource risks but were patched before Polygon publicly disclosed them.

latest.title: Op-ed: Dolly Parton was underestimated for decades. That became one of her greatest strengths
latest.description: In a candid 2015 interview, Dolly Parton told CNBC's Tania Bryer about depression, ambition and the business decisions that defined her career.

latest.title: K, C or E? Why economists can’t agree on the shape of today’s economy
latest.description: Economists have long viewed the post-pandemic economy as "K"-shaped. That consensus has now evaporated.

latest.title: Tech backlash reaches fever pitch as AI angst collides with social media fears
latest.description: With data center concerns becoming a major election issue and Meta reaching a landmark settlement in a social media case, the tech backlash is gaining steam.

latest.title: Stellar tokenized RWA market more than quadruples to nearly $4B
latest.description: Stellar’s real-world asset market has expanded rapidly this year as institutional adoption and tokenization activity grow across the network.

latest.title: OpenAI to end model access to Cursor after acquisition by Elon Musk's SpaceX
latest.description: OpenAI plans to end model access through Cursor on Nov. 12, citing concerns after SpaceX’s $60 billion acquisition of the coding startup.

latest.title: National Park Service backs Trump’s 250-foot arch despite ‘adverse effects’ on historic sites
latest.description: The park service is backing the arch, despite finding that it would adversely affect historic sightlines and other visual relationships among nearby landmarks.

latest.title: Trump administration weighs Yosemite land swap for private developer’s access road
latest.description: The Trump administration is considering a Yosemite land exchange that could give a developer more direct park access.

latest.title: Bernie Sanders Vows Legislation to 'Stop Flock and AI Mass Surveillance'
latest.description: The Vermont senator warned that the surveillance company's 120,000-plus AI cameras are pushing the US toward a "surveillance state," adding a prominent voice to a growing bipartisan backlash.

latest.title: Tokenized stock transfer volume jumps 415% in 30 days to $29.5B
latest.description: Tokenized equities saw a sharp rise in onchain activity as active addresses and holders more than doubled over the past month.

latest.title: Bitcoin's Oldest Coins Are Waking Up in 2026 at a Pace Rarely Seen
latest.description: Galaxy Research shows coins untouched for 10-plus years moving at an unusual pace in 2026, with six ancient wallets shifting $40 million in a single 10-day stretch this month.

latest.title: Ditching 'digital gold': BPI study suggests everyday Americans prefer control and micro-investing
latest.description: A new survey suggests some of bitcoin's most familiar sales pitches of changing the world may be poorly suited to a majority of prospective buyers.

latest.title: Inside the high-stakes battle between digital dollars and Swift's massive money engine
latest.description: Crypto executives say new blockchain payment infrastructure could make Swift obsolete. Bankers say its 11,500-institution network gives it the power to absorb the technology instead.

latest.title: The next trillion-dollar currency may not be a stablecoin — it might not even have a name yet
latest.description: AI agents are coming. They will need to pay each other. Crypto executives agree on the problem but disagree sharply on the solution, and one thinks the answer has not been invented yet.

latest.title: We're in the midst of an 'Imax awakening,' CEO says. How the company makes millions
latest.description: Christopher Nolan's "The Odyssey" has movie and history buffs flocking to theaters this summer. That's been great news for Imax.

latest.title: Goodyear burning rubber and cash as turnaround plan continues
latest.description: The tire maker has an ongoing turnaround plan as the company tries to restructure its business, refinance and pay down years of debt.

latest.title: BitGo Buys NYDIG's Institutional Trading Arm to Beef Up Derivatives and Financing
latest.description: The roughly $42.5 million cash-and-stock deal adds derivatives, structured products and capital-markets capabilities, while letting NYDIG focus on its power and data-center business.

latest.title: The big lesson from this week's earnings: The AI buildout is not a zero-sum game
latest.description: Salesforce, CrowdStrike, and Nvidia all faced major tests with investors and crushed expectations.

latest.title: Op-ed: Salesforce just revealed the next battleground in AI — and it's not the models
latest.description: For the past year, markets have vaporized roughly $2 trillion in software value by asking the wrong question about AI.
